Builder.summary: Builders thrive on creating and optimizing systems. They combine high cognitive and adversity quotients to solve complex problems.

Leader.summary: Leaders excel at rallying teams and building culture. They leverage high emotional and social intelligence.

Rainmaker.summary: Rainmakers are natural advocates and relationship builders. They use social and adversity quotients to drive growth.

Anchor.summary: Anchors provide stability and process. They combine cognitive and emotional intelligence to manage operations effectively.

AQ.low_feedback: Your AQ is below 50. Consider engaging in resilience-building exercises and taking on challenging projects with mentorship.

SQ.high_feedback: Your SQ is high (> 80). Suggest pursuing leadership roles in student clubs or organizing community events.

IQ.low_feedback: Consider supplemental courses or study groups to strengthen core problem-solving (IQ) skills.

EQ.high_feedback: Your EQ is excellent. You might make a great peer mentor or team mediator.

SpQ.high_feedback: Your SpQ is high (> 75). Purpose-driven leadership is a strong growth vector for you. Consider leading cross-functional initiative projects.
SpQ.low_feedback: Your SpQ score is below 40. Engaging in value-alignment reflection and mission-driven projects can help expand your perspective.
